title: The Visconti Italian cipher, Brussels-London 1727, BL Add MS 32270 f. 42 (DECODE R7931)

steps.what: Listed every DECODE record at Add MS 32270 from the harvested list: all are keys except R7927, R7929, R7930, R7931; R7932 and R7933 are Visconti keys on the next leaves.
Fetched R7931, R7932, R7933 images with the stored DECODE cookie.

Recognised R7931 as a fair-copy key table (1-300) endorsed 'Count Visconti at Bruxelles with Marq.s Visconti here 1727 Italian Cypher', not a letter; R7932 its working draft; R7933 a French key for the same parties.
Transcribed the 193 filled places of f. 42 to key_f42.tsv.

outcome.method_basis: DECODE R7931 (BL Add MS 32270 f. 42) is the Deciphering Branch's fair-copy key table for the Visconti Italian cipher of 1727, mistyped as a ciphertext; there is no message on the leaf.
outcome.notes: Catalogued ciphertext is a key table (the solution, not a message); nothing to decipher. 33 'Rialso' and 172 'Reggenza' doubtful readings.

prior.where: The leaf is the Deciphering Branch's own 1727 reconstruction of the key; DECODE typed it as a ciphertext.

human: Project-level: obtained a DECODE login and passed its session cookie to the model, posed the target with /goal from the catalogue. No target-specific intervention.
